tei:div.tei:p: dpe skrun gsal bshad/ rang re'i mes po mkhas dbang dam pa rim byon gyi rnam dpyod lto ba yangs pa'i rtsal las rab tu 'khrungs pa'i gtsug lag ni nam mkha'i mtha' ltar mnyam la ri rab lhun po'i dpangs las mtho ba/ rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jings bzhin zab pa bcas 'dzam gling skye 'gro kun gyi mthong chos su gyur cing*/ de dag ni rang rigs kyi rin thang gzhal du med pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin la/ mes rgyal shes rig bang mdzod nang gi gzi sbyin 'od snang 'phro ba'i gces nor yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling shes rig bang mdzod chen mo'i khrod kyi ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchog nor yang yin/ 'on kyang de dag mi lo brgya phrag stong phrag nang mi dang rang byung gis 'tshe bas rkyen pas nyams brlag tu phyin dang 'gro la khad du thug cing*/ de dag gi nang don kha cig yul dang dus kyis bskal bas shin tu rtogs dka' bar gyur te/ dus phyis zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi bya rgyur 'gog rkyen 'phrad kyi yod/ bod du bcings 'grol btang rjes dang lhag par du tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshun/ tang dang rgyal khab nas mi shugs dang rgyu stobs kyi mthun rkyen bzang po sbyar te shul du lus pa'i gtsug lag mang dag cig myur skyob dang*/ 'tshol bsdu/ legs sgrig /par skrun bcas mdzad de grub 'bras mi dman pa thob dang 'thob bzhin pa lags/ 'on kyang bya ba 'di ni rgya che zhing zhib tshags pa dang*/ gting dpog dka' ba'i las gzhi rlabs po che zhig yin gshis/ mdun skyod kyi lam bu kyag kyog kyang kyong dang*/ tha na tsher ma'i tshang tshing gis yongs su gtums pa'ang 'byung srid pas rang re'i srid gzhung dang*/ 'brel yod sde tshan/ mnyam sdeb/ spyi dmangs mi sger bcas kyis mnyam las phyar ba gru 'degs dang*/ jo rtse zong kha gcig sgril/ thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sprugs bcas kyis rang ngos nas 'go brtsams pa dang bya ba'i sne mo re re bzhin snying rus chen pos rgyun bskyangs nas bsgrubs tshe/

dka' tshegs mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal te byas rjes drud shul thon pa zhig yong thub snyam/ da phan mi lo bcu grangs nang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam dang ngal ba khur bzod kyi snying stobs la brten nas 'bad 'bungs lhur len gyis bod kyi sa gnas grong khyer dang*/ rdzong dang shang*/ tha na mtha' 'khob lung khug gi grong tsho dang 'brog dgon sogs gang sar phebs nas de khul du shin tu nyag phra zhing thar thor du lus pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon mang dag cig myur skyob 'tshol bsdu dang*/ legs sgrig dpe skrun mdzad pa kun gyis mig mthong lag zin byung bas snying khams dbus nas dad gus dang rjes su yi rang zhu rgyu yin/ bod mi rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas shul bzhag 'tshol bsdu dang*/ legs sgrig /dpe skrun bcas byas te deng gi spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs dang*/ phyi rabs rgyud bcas rnams la skyes su 'bul rgyu'i dmigs yul dang*/ dgos pa/ phan rlabs bcas la blo kha gcig mthun thog da lam dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang*/ 'di ga bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib 'jug gros mol thengs mang byas mthar/ khong rnam pas 'tshol bsdu legs sgrig mdzad pa'i gsung rab dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen khag nged dpe skrun khang gis rim bzhin dpe skrun bya gtan 'khel ba bzhin/ da lan mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs khongs su¡¶dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i mdo yi don snang bar byed pa'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /¡·zhes bya ba 'di dpe skrun zhus pa yin zhing*/ dpe deb 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad zhib tshags nan tur byas khul lags kyang da dung skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig yod srid stabs/ mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis nor bcos kyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen/
